titulo: Test the pen before you lend it
caption:
Test the pen before you lend it

Cella tries the pen on a sheet of paper first. It works, so it goes across to the other one.

For whoever checks the pen before lending it.

Choose friction.

alt: A short film with no voice, with music. A room with a pink wall. A small ink-black block figure with white eyes stands on the left and a royal blue one stands on the right. A small yellow pen floats over to a sheet of paper standing between them and scribbles on it. A green check appears with a bubble that says it works. The pen then floats across to the royal blue figure, whose eyes go wide and then close in a smile, and a star appears above it. The black one smiles and pulses. The text stays: 1 pen, test it before you lend it. The last card: for whoever checks the pen before lending it, Choose friction.
